en.headline: Observatory issues Amber Rainstorm Warning amid overnight thunderstorms
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 3:50am and maintained a Thunderstorm Warning valid until 5am as heavy showers affect the city.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 3:50am on Saturday, indicating that heavy rain exceeding 30 millimetres an hour has fallen or is expected generally over Hong Kong and is likely to continue.

A Thunderstorm Warning issued at 12:45am remains in force until 5am, with a few squally thunderstorms expected over the territory. The Observatory advised the public to seek safe shelter if outdoors, leave the water and avoid swimming, and keep away from high ground, trees or conductive objects.

Earlier special weather tips warned that rain areas near the Pearl River Estuary and southern waters were approaching, bringing periods of heavy showers. Many places recorded more than 10 millimetres around midnight.

The Observatory forecasts mainly cloudy conditions with occasional showers today, heavy at times with a few squally thunderstorms at first before easing with sunny periods. Temperatures will range from 22 to 27 degrees. Sunday is expected to be mainly fine.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色暴雨警告 雷暴警告維持至上午5時
zh.dek: 香港天文台凌晨3時50分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，同時雷暴警告有效至上午5時，本港受大驟雨影響。
body: 香港天文台於周六凌晨3時50分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示香港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時雨量超過30毫米的大雨，且雨勢可能持續。
凌晨12時45分發出的雷暴警告仍然生效，有效至上午5時，預料香港有幾陣狂風雷暴。天文台提醒市民如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面切勿戶外游泳，並勿站立於高地或接近樹木及導電物體。
較早前特別天氣提示指，珠江口以西及香港以南海域的雨區正逐漸靠近，未來數小時本港雨勢有時頗大。午夜前後多處地區錄得超過10毫米雨量。
天文台預料今日大致多雲，間中有驟雨，初時雨勢有時頗大及有幾陣狂風雷暴，日間驟雨減少並有陽光。氣溫介乎22至27度。星期日大致天晴。
